name: Subscription you cannot cancel

queries: {country} cancellation auto-renewal subscription consumer protection rule
{company} cancellation policy terms of service refund policy
{company} subscription cancellation complaint similar resolved case

evaluationPrompt: Determine whether the company made cancellation unreasonably difficult compared to signup. Check whether charges were taken after a valid cancellation attempt. Check whether the company's own policy promises something it failed to do. Return findings with source IDs and supporting passages.
compensationLogic: Refund amounts come from the charges-after-cancellation documented in the facts and any refund rule found in the sources; no amounts are estimated from memory.
letterTemplate: Timeline of cancellation attempts, the rule and policy cited, a demand to cancel and refund specific charges, and a deadline.

IN: Consumer regulator (e.g. Department of Consumer Affairs / CCPA)
EU: National consumer protection authority / European Consumer Centre
US: Federal Trade Commission or state attorney general
